_review: English source (design canvas boards W1–W5). Placeholders in {braces} are filled by backend/app/wa_flow.py. The 'app' section is copied from the app's own wording by scripts/sync_whatsapp_text.py; don't edit it here.
greeting:
Hello, I’m *Magana* 👋
Send me a photo of any printed page and I’ll read it to you, as text and as a voice note.

First, which language do you want?
language_set: Thank you! I’ll speak English from now on. You can change it any time by sending “language”.
adult_ready:
Thank you. Your photos are read and then deleted. I never ask for a PIN or password.

📄 Send a page whenever you’re ready. Send “help” any time.
under_18:
Thank you for telling me. Magana on WhatsApp is for adults.

Please use the *Magana app* with your teacher or a parent or guardian. They can set it up for you and help you learn with it.
under_18_goodbye: Take care! Ask your teacher about Magana. 💚
page_header: *Your page*, {count} lines, read exactly as printed:
page_header_one: *Your page*, 1 line, read exactly as printed:
no_text: I couldn’t find any printed text in that photo. Please send another photo with the whole page in view, in good light.
unreadable_photo: I couldn’t open that photo. Please send it again as a photo, not a document.
faint: ⚠️ Part of the page ({where}) has print I couldn’t read. Please check it with someone near you, or send a clearer photo.
warn_number: ⚠️ I couldn’t read a number clearly on line {line}. Please check it with a pharmacist or someone near you, or send a clearer photo.
warn_unsure: ⚠️ I’m not sure about line {line}. Please check it, or send a clearer photo.
warn_line_end: ⚠️ I couldn’t read the end of line {line}. Please check it, or send a clearer photo.
voice_intro: Here is your page, read exactly as printed.
voice_warn_number: I couldn’t read that number clearly. Please check it with a pharmacist or someone near you.
voice_warn_unsure: I’m not sure about that line. Please check it.
voice_warn_line_end: I couldn’t read the end of that line. Please check it.
voice_unsafe: I couldn’t make a voice note that says every word and number correctly, so this page is text only.
voice_not_ready: Voice notes in English aren’t ready yet. The text above is exact.
help_text:
*How to use Magana*
• Send a photo of a printed page: I send back the text exactly as printed, and a voice note.
• Numbers I can’t read clearly are said as “unclear number”. I never guess them.
• I don’t explain health or money papers, and I don’t give medical or financial advice.
• “Talk to a health worker” asks a few questions so a nurse knows how soon to call you.
• Send “language” to change language.

🚨 In an emergency, call *112*.
read_again_expired: I no longer have your last page: I keep it for 30 minutes only. Please send the photo again.
send_a_photo: Please send a photo of a printed page. I can’t answer typed questions yet. Send “help” to see what I can do.
busy: Magana is busy right now. Please send the photo again in a minute.
triage_intro:
I’ll ask a few quick questions so a nurse knows how soon to call you. Answer with the buttons.

🚨 If this is an emergency, call *112* now.
cant_tell_noted: That’s okay. Please ask someone near you to check, or go to a clinic. I’ll note it so the nurse calls you sooner.
last_question: Thank you. That was the last question.
callback_desk_down: I couldn’t reach the nurse desk just now. If you need help now, go to a clinic or call 112.
ask_number: Please send the phone number the nurse should call, starting with 0 or +234.
bad_number: That doesn’t look like a Nigerian phone number. Please send it again, for example 0803 123 4567.
number_changed: Thank you. The nurse will call {number}.
call_cancelled: Your call-back is cancelled. Send “health worker” if you need one again.
callback_expired: That call-back is no longer open. Send “health worker” to ask for a new one.
keep_phone_near: Keep your phone near you. If you get worse, go to a clinic or call 112.
limit_reached: Magana on WhatsApp has reached its limit for this month. Please use the Magana app: magana.ng/android. In an emergency, call 112.
after_reading: Send another page whenever you’re ready, or choose:

app.q_bleeding: Are you bleeding without a clear reason, from the nose or gums, or in vomit or stool?
app.q_bleeding_no_sight: Have you felt or tasted blood, or has anyone told you that you are bleeding, from your nose, gums, vomit or stool?
app.q_cannot_drink: Are you unable to drink anything, or is the baby unable to breastfeed?
app.q_dark_urine: Is your urine very dark, like cola or tea?
app.q_dark_urine_no_sight: Has someone near you seen that your urine is very dark, like cola or tea?
app.q_fever: Do you have a fever, or does your body feel very hot?
app.q_fever_days: For how many days have you had the fever?
app.q_fits: Have you had fits, or shaking of the body you could not stop?
app.q_hard_breathing: Are you breathing very fast, or struggling to breathe?
app.q_too_weak: Are you too weak to sit up or stand without help?
app.q_very_pale: Are your palms, lips or inner eyelids very pale?
app.q_very_pale_no_sight: Has anyone told you that you look very pale? Do you feel very weak, dizzy or out of breath when you stand?
app.q_very_sleepy: Are you very sleepy, confused, or hard to wake?
app.q_vomits_everything: Are you vomiting everything you eat or drink?
app.q_yellow_eyes: Have your eyes or skin turned yellow?
app.q_yellow_eyes_no_sight: Has anyone told you that your eyes or skin look yellow?
app.go_to_clinic_now: This could be serious. Please go to the nearest clinic now, or call 112. Do not wait for a call back.
app.nurse_call_within_2_hours: Thank you. A nurse will call you within 2 hours.
app.nurse_call_working_hours: Thank you. A nurse will call you back during working hours.
app.ask_someone_to_check: Please ask someone near you to check, or go to a clinic.
app.callback_booked: Your call back is booked. A nurse or pharmacist will call you.
app.callback_unavailable: Call backs are not available yet. If you need help now, go to a clinic or call 112.

voice_numbers_in_text: Some numbers are only in the text message: please read it there.
